findings.title: New BlackX UEFI bootkit exploiting Baton Drop - Securelist (Kaspersky)
findings.summary_md: Kaspersky GReAT researchers discovered the BlackX UEFI bootkit, which exploits CVE-2022-21894 (Baton Drop) to bypass Secure Boot. The malware targets diplomatic agencies in Central Asia and resembles the BlackLotus bootkit, using an unrevoked vulnerable boot manager binary for persistence.

findings.title: Microsoft Security Update Guide - CVE-2022-21894 (Baton Drop)
findings.summary_md: Microsoft published the advisory for CVE-2022-21894 in January 2022, identifying it as a Secure Boot Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability later nicknamed Baton Drop. The advisory documents the vulnerability that BlackX revives to bypass Secure Boot on fully patched systems missing revocation updates.
